description: Start a fax to a US fax number. Opens a form in this chat where the user adds pages from their phone camera or a PDF, adds an optional cover page, and pays. The fax costs $2.99 flat for up to 25 pages and is charged only when delivery is confirmed. No account is needed. Nothing is sent or charged until the user confirms and pays in that form. A file attached to this chat cannot be passed to this tool, so the user adds the document inside the form, and a document already attached does not need to be uploaded to the chat again. On a host that cannot show the form, this returns a link that opens the same flow in a browser.

agency.description: The agency the fax is going to, if known. Used for reporting only.

fax_number.description: The destination US fax number, in any format, including as printed on a letter or form the user attached.

language.description: Language for the response. Defaults to English.

name: send_fax
